answer: Continuous physical custody challenge: each identity must submit live video of a token—an ivory keytag with a random opal inlay pattern—beside an unlisted landmark, e.g., a mesa overlook, with GPS and timestamp cross-checked against satellite imagery and prior submissions. A single operator cannot film N tokens at N distant sites simultaneously, since each challenge specifies location and time window. Duplicates fail because the same token cannot appear at two coordinates in one window. Cost: one token, courier, and site visit per identity, scaling linearly and geographically.
